output.summary: Arts' resolution gap is mainly structural, not bias. SlotBook tickets (42%) are auto-routed by RR-17 to a no-target P4 queue (median 21 days, 17 waiting before first action). Excluding them closes 70% of the gap. The rest is largely the Tuesday/Thursday-only Lindqvist on-site cover. Matched remote categories show parity, so the deprioritisation and trivial-ticket claims are contradicted. Volume is not fully explained by SlotBook. The ACK-P4 template hides best-effort status from requesters. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished: there is no record of the meeting, and the Director and Dean disagree. Preferred actions: written support agreement plus a fixed acknowledgement, and split reporting. Blanket P4, forced decommission and a separate desk are harmful or premature.
